Part VII · The Deal

Five steps from hello to results.

Everything in this dossier is already built. Already proven. Already producing results. The only question left is whether you want to put it to work.

01

You tell us what's broken

Describe the pain points — the missed calls, the lost leads, the paperwork eating your weekends. No pitch.

30 min call
02

We agree on the plan

We put the scope, price, and timeline in writing. Most projects begin with a deposit. For service trades, advertising exchanges, or combined arrangements, we agree on the value and commitments up front.

Before work begins
03

We build. You see it working.

We configure, customize, and test your solution, then walk you through it with your branding and workflow. You know what done looks like before we start.

1 session
04

We go live together

We launch your solution and help you put it to work. Payments follow the schedule we agreed on, with milestones for larger projects.

Day one
05

We keep making it better

Monthly reports, quarterly reviews, ongoing improvements. You never go back to "figuring it out yourself."

Ongoing
